plan.noise_definition: noise_factor 1.2 scales I/Q standard deviation, not variance or dB
plan.policy: Frozen original 8000-sample detector, two-node OR, require both usable reports
plan.injection_policy: Independent 20% loss per report; node 0 20 ms delay on frames 10..19 modulo 40; node 0 absent middle 20% of frames
limitations: Simulated transport/common sample clock and local batch receipts
Strict increasing sequence policy; legitimate delayed reports can be rejected
No timing calibration or deployed blockchain; frame observations are not independent trials
